text:
maria_sales: Quick help — Clearpath (enterprise POC) needs a hosted API quota bump for 2 weeks. They expect bursty inference (chat streaming) up to ~50 concurrent requests and roughly 400k-600k tokens/day. Can we do a temporary increase on their API key? They start Monday.

sanjay_eng: Got it. Are they using streaming responses or sync generation? Which model? region?

maria_sales: Streaming chat via rw-v2-13b in us-west. Will be via a single API key (poc-clearpath-01). No embeddings.

olivia_devex: Two quick asks we need to decide: 1) exact request concurrency limit (50 conc is fine as a target) 2) token-based quota or rps-based? For streaming we normally cap concurrent streams + token throughput.

maria_sales: Tell them we want 50 concurrent streams and a soft token cap of 700k tokens/day to be safe. Duration 14 days.

kai_infra: For hosted plan we can create a scoped API key + quota policy. Ops question: is this sustained or very spiky? If sustained >200r/s we should push Dedicated.

maria_sales: It's bursty during demos, not sustained. Peak hour maybe 200r/s for a few mins, otherwise much lower.

support-bot: Automated note: Please file an internal infra request with label `poc-rate-bump` if you require >100r/s sustained. Ticket template: customer, root cause, start/end, requested limits, owner contact.

olivia_devex: OK — plan: we create a temporary API key scoped to the customer org, set concurrent_streams=60, tokens_per_day=700000, and a short TTL (expires after 15 days). Also enable enhanced monitoring on that key so we can roll back if error rates or cost spike.

sanjay_eng: Technical details for infra ticket: include model (rw-v2-13b), region (us-west-2), desired concurrency=60, max_burst_rps=250, token_quota=700000/day, key_name=poc-clearpath-01, start=1743255600, end=1744491600, contact=maria_sales. Recommend adding the key to a special billing bucket `poc-clearpath` so we can track cost.

maria_sales: Perfect. I'll open the ticket now and paste the request. Can infra confirm ETA? Customer wants it by Monday EOD.

kai_infra: ETA depends on approvals. If billing bucket exists and security ok we can do same-day. Need sign-off from revenue ops on discount/credits. I'll take it once ticket created.

olivia_devex: Note on rate-limit headers to tell customer: we return `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, and `Retry-After` on 429s. For streaming we also recommend client-side backpressure and exponential backoff on 5xx.

sanjay_eng: Add a short snippet for the customer (curl):
```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $POC_KEY" \n  -d '{"model":"rw-v2-13b","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}],"stream":true}' \n  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat 
```

maria_sales: Copying to customer. One security question: do we need a separate VPC or is hosted okay for this POC? They asked about data residency.

olivia_devex: Hosted is fine for a POC if they don't send PHI. If they require VPC/private, that moves to Private/Dedicated and needs SOW. For hosted POC we can add an NDA clause and ephemeral key but not VPC.

kai_infra: Also adding: if the customer requests IP allowlist, we can configure key-scoped allowlist. Include the IPs in the ticket.

maria_sales: Thanks all. I'll create the internal ticket with the fields Sanjay listed and tag @kai_infra and @olivia_devex. Will update here after ticket created. :thumbsup:

support-bot: Ticket created: #INC-2026-781 (poc-rate-bump). Assigned to kai_infra. ETA: 8 business hours.
